About Me

Turning data chaos into business clarity

📍 Mansoura, Egypt
·
✈ Ready to Relocate

I'm a Data Analyst and BI Developer with a Computer & Information Sciences degree from Mansoura University (Grade: Very Good) and intensive professional training from ITI's Power BI Development Track.

My work spans the entire data lifecycle — from architecting Galaxy Schema data warehouses and building SSIS ETL pipelines to designing DAX-powered Power BI dashboards that give executives real-time visibility into churn, revenue, and operational performance.

I'm driven by one question: what decision does this data need to enable? Every pipeline I build and every dashboard I design is anchored in business outcomes, not just technical deliverables.

SILA Telecom — Service Level Dashboard
Business Problem

Telecom call center had no unified view of SLA compliance across thousands of calls monthly. Built a live Power BI dashboard tracking 16K answered calls, SLA breach rates, wait time patterns by hour, and regional service coverage across Egypt.

📈 Business Impact73.17% SLA achievement tracked in real time. Enabled management to spot peak-hour bottlenecks and reduce outside-SLA calls from 26.56% with targeted staffing adjustments.

Sales Performance & Logistics Analysis
Business Problem

Operations team had no visibility into order trends, category performance, or freight cost patterns across 22.5K+ orders and $87.7M in total due. Built an end-to-end Power BI dashboard with geo-mapping, category breakdowns, and year-over-year trend analysis.

📈 Business ImpactProcessed 22.5K+ orders ($87.7M total due). Automated cost-to-delivery tracking with $2.27M freight visibility and identified that 8.27% of orders are weekend orders — enabling smarter logistics scheduling.
